verdict.rationale: Mixpanel exposes fully programmatic APIs (Ingestion API, Raw/Query Export APIs, Query API, JQL with a main() function executed server-side) that can be scripted and run without any UI, supporting headless/automated use in pipelines or CI jobs. However, there is no documented CLI, GitHub Action, or explicit CI/CD integration guide — the evidence only shows raw HTTP/JS APIs, not turnkey automation tooling. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI or SDK for CI pipelines, explicit CI/CD examples or automation templates, and any independent confirmation of headless usage in production automation.
